messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Hexagonal close packing scaled to the unit square

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration within the unit square for maximizing the minimum triangle area consists of a single interior point placed at the exact center (1/2, 1/2), surrounded by a 12-point hexagonal lattice ring scaled to fit the boundary constraints with outer points at (1/2±1/√3, 1/2±1/2), (1/2±1/(2√3), 1/2±1), (1/2, 1/2±1/√3) and boundary-clamped permutations thereof. This arrangement achieves a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/(6√3) ≈ 0.0962, arising from the smallest fundamental equilateral triangles in the hexagonal lattice. Any perturbation of the interior point away from the center or any alternative spacing of the hexagonal ring strictly decreases the minimum triangle area below this value."}
